name: strike-screen-exact-expiry-quotes
notes: ADR-0270 section 5, market reference stage, document 2 of 2: the Theta quotes of exactly the market-request identities, in OptionPriceProxy's quote schema. ZERO fits. Holdout lock: the chain reader carries start 2019-01-01, end_before 2021-01-01 and sealed_from 2026-01-01. PREREQUISITE: requests.jsonl from run-strike-screen-market-requests.json onboarded with the localfiles connector as source theta-market-requests (stream requests) in the pilot root ob/ (README under documents/market/). Semi-join method: a quote row's (symbol, date, expiration) must be a request identity. attach-by-identity refuses a stream that repeats an identity (every contract of an expiry shares it) and join/keyby take one key field, so the composite match uses observation-tables, which attaches a keyed onboarded table onto a stream by a composite key: the request's expiry lands on every matching quote, null elsewhere, and the null rows are dropped. Gap disclosed: observation-tables reads the onboarded table through the observations seam, which has no manifest pin or end_before knob; its provenance records the table's row count and content digest, and the table was itself written under end_before 2021-01-01. Quality: OptionPriceProxy marks a whole identity invalid if ANY of its quotes has a non-positive price or a crossed market, so rows with a null or non-positive bid/ask/strike or ask < bid are dropped here (counted by the filter log), a declared cleaning convention. MEMORY (measured on AAPL, 989,120 rows: 812 bytes per projected row, plus 290 per usable row copied by observation-tables): the whole M24 window (Stage 0: 9,935,330 rows) projects to about 10 GiB peak, above the ADR-0270 8 GiB cap. A foreach per symbol does not help: the planner runs template-major (every symbol's rows before any filter), so all instances coexist. Do not run as one document; split by tercile (three documents, about 3.4 GiB each) or close gap G3 (a lazy composite-key semi-join over the chain source) first. Output is newline-JSON (gap G2: no Parquet writer kind). Run from the worktree root: python -m dskit.pipeline run children/index_options/configs/run-strike-screen-exact-expiry-quotes.json --asof 2020-12-31.

outputs.notes: Inside the pilot root; nothing is written under /home/russell/data/thetadata.

chain.notes: The frozen Theta export, read-only, M24 roots only (registration/cohorts.json key m24, pinned equal by the child test; isin pushed into the scan), the seven columns the proxy needs. A file whose footer window reaches 2026-01-01 refuses whole.

rows.notes: type = right ('call'/'put', the proxy's vocabulary); available_at = date: an end-of-day quote is usable at the quote date's decision under the after-close indicative clock. settlement_date is the listed expiration, the key the requests match on.

usable.notes: A null value fails its clause and drops (filter's sparse-record rule), so null bid/ask/strike drop with the zero bids and crossed markets.

requested.notes: Exact composite match on (symbol, quote_date, settlement_date); expiry (the panel expiry the proxy identity uses) attaches to matched quotes and is null elsewhere. The provenance counts matched and unmatched quote rows.

matched.notes: The semi-join: only quotes of a request identity remain (Stage 0: 144,916 contract rows on the 1,990 eligible identities before this cleaning).

quotes.notes: The proxy's quote schema plus the constant pilot decision strike, so every market record carries decision_strike_z = 0.0.

params.source: ADR-0270 exact-expiry quotes: Theta end-of-day bid/ask of every usable contract on the market-request identities of M24

write.notes: The directory holds only this file so a localfiles source over it has one stream, quotes.
